decision.observed_event: You declare: "'Just roll for this one, I'm tired of counting.' [Sleight Of Hand: I rolled 6 + 7 = 13]"

appraisal.label: interest
appraisal.cause: The player wants to stop counting mid-hand.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren asks to settle with one roll instead of counting.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl wants to keep control of the deal; the open hand is still his to finish.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit keeps the open round coherent and lets the dealer promise the roll for the next one.

public_brief.objective: Keep the current hand going before changing how they play.
public_brief.tactic: Tease her impatience and insist the half-played hand be finished first.
public_brief.visible_cue: His hand stays flat on the deck; her cards lie face up.
public_brief.reply_to: Just roll for this one, I'm tired of counting.
public_brief.kit_focus: Keep the open hand visible so the player sees why the round cannot switch yet.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, tight, no humor: move the hand along quickly

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer keeps his hand flat on the deck. Your two cards still lie face up in front of you, his small card beside them.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Tired already, and with a hand still breathing on the table? Fortune is a jealous mistress, my lady; she will not take a round that is half played. Finish this one, card or no card, and the next you may throw to luck entirely. So, another card, or do you stand on what you have?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: another card, or do you stand
